factors: t-stat momentum: mean/log-return over mom_fast=12d divided by its std, x sqrt(12)
vol-normalized slow momentum: 127d return / (realized vol over vol_win=36d x sqrt(127))
blend: 0.19 x fast + 0.81 x slow, cross-sectionally ranked across the 20 pairs (scaffold, shift(1))
turnover_control: rank-hysteresis exit_buffer=0.22 (exit only when rank leaves the threshold by a margin) + min_hold=1d; wide 5-long/3-short book; daily timeframe chosen to keep traded volume low (~11x/yr train, ~25x/yr valid one-way notional over wallet)
